title: 小众香水 Shopify 详情页和九张商品图
summary: 为虚构香水 Atelier Oubli Nº 7「Fig & Smoke」画出九张暗调油画感商品图（主图、四个角度、微距、原料、床头场景、包装盒），再做一个桌面和手机通用的 HTML 商品页原型，含规格切换、香调金字塔、留香时间轴和配送退换折叠面板。

   Atelier Oubli — Nº 7 "Fig & Smoke" — product page
   Palette: umber #2A1E17 · fig #5B2A3C · brass #B08D57 · bone #E8E0D2
   Type: Cormorant Garamond (italic headlines) · small-caps grotesk UI
   ========================================================= */

:root {
  --umber: #2A1E17;
  --umber-deep: #1F1611;
  --umber-ink: #150F0B;
  --umber-lift: #36271E;
  --fig: #5B2A3C;

  --line: rgba(232, 224, 210, 0.13);
  --line-strong: rgba(232, 224, 210, 0.26);

  --serif: "Cormorant Garamond", "Cormorant", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;

/* ---------- Base ---------- */

.menu-toggle {

.site-header.is-open .menu-toggle__bars::after { top: 4px; transform: rotate(-45deg); }

/* ---------- Breadcrumbs ---------- */

/* ---------- Product ---------- */
.product { padding: 28px 0 140px; }

.product__grid {

  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 760px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 72px;

}

.product__gallery {

/* Gallery */
.gallery {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: start;
}

.gallery__thumbs {
  list-style: none;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  max-height: 846px;

.gallery__thumbs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

.gallery__thumb {

.gallery__thumb img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; }

.gallery__main { min-width: 0; }

.gallery__stage {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
  overflow: hidden;

  cursor: zoom-in;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;

.gallery__stage::after {
  /* thin inner frame, like a canvas edge */

  position: absolute; inset: 0;

  pointer-events: none;

.gallery__img {
  width: 100%;

.gallery__img.is-fading { opacity: 0; }

.gallery__stage.is-zoomed { cursor: zoom-out; touch-action: none; }

.stars { color: var(--brass); letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 14px; font-family: var(--sans); }

/* Notes summary: on wide screens columns size to their content so no line wraps */
.notes-mini {

/* Size selector */
.size { border: 0; margin: 38px 0 0; padding: 0; min-width: 0; }

.upsell {

.check {

.pyramid {
  display: grid;

        strip.scrollTo({ top: thumb.offsetTop - (strip.clientHeight - thumb.offsetHeight) / 2, behavior: behavior });
      }
    }

    function show(i, focusThumb) {
      var n = thumbs.length;
      i = ((i % n) + n) % n;
      if (i === index) { if (focusThumb) thumbs[i].focus(); return; }
      index = i;
      setZoom(false);
      centreOrigin();

      thumbs.forEach(function (t, k) { t.setAttribute('aria-current', k === i ? 'true' : 'false'); });
      if (focusThumb) thumbs[i].focus({ preventScroll: true });
      scrollStripTo(thumbs[i]);
      updateCount();

      var thumb = thumbs[i];
      window.clearTimeout(swapTimer);
      img.classList.add('is-fading');
      swapTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
        img.src = thumb.dataset.src;
        img.alt = thumb.dataset.alt || '';
        var done = function () { window.requestAnimationFrame(function () { img.classList.remove('is-fading'); }); };
        if (img.decode) { img.decode().then(done, done); }
        else if (img.complete) { done(); }
        else { img.addEventListener('load', done, { once: true }); }
      }, reduceMotion ? 0 : 420);
    }

    // thumbnails
    thumbs.forEach(function (t, k) {
      t.addEventListener('click', function () { show(k); });
      t.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        var key = e.key;
        if (key === 'ArrowDown' || key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); show(index + 1, true); }
        else if (key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); show(index - 1, true); }
        else if (key === 'Home') { e.preventDefault(); show(0, true); }
        else if (key === 'End') { e.preventDefault(); show(thumbs.length - 1, true); }
      });
    });

    // arrows (mobile)
    [[prevBtn, -1], [nextBtn, 1]].forEach(function (pair) {
      if (!pair[0]) return;
      pair[0].addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        show(index + pair[1]);
      });
      pair[0].addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    });

    // desktop: hover to magnify, follow the cursor
    stage.addEventListener('pointerenter', function (e) {
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && finePointer.matches) { setOrigin(e); setZoom(true); }
    });
    stage.addEventListener('pointerleave', function (e) {
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') setZoom(false);
    });
    stage.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      if (zoomed) setOrigin(e);
    });

    // touch: swipe to change image, tap to zoom, drag to pan
    stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
      if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;
      start = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    });
    stage.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) {
      if (!start || e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;
      var dx = e.clientX - start.x;
      var dy = e.clientY - start.y;
      start = null;
      if (!zoomed && Math.abs(dx) > 40 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.3) {
        suppressClick = true;
        show(index + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
      }
    });
    stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', function () { start = null; });

    stage.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (suppressClick) { suppressClick = false; return; }
      setOrigin(e);
      setZoom(!zoomed);
    });

    if (zoomBtn) {
      zoomBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        centreOrigin();
        setZoom(!zoomed);
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && zoomed) setZoom(false);
    });

    img.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
    updateCount();

  /* ---------- Size, upsell, add to bag ---------- */
  function initPurchase() {
    var sizes = $$('input[name="size"]');

    var cartTotal = parseInt(cartCounts.length ? cartCounts[0].textContent : '0', 10) || 0;
    var resetTimer = null;

    function currentSize() {
      var s = sizes.find(function (x) { return x.checked; }) || sizes[0];
      return s ? { price: Number(s.dataset.price) || 0, label: s.dataset.label || s.value } : { price: 0, label: '' };

    function setCtaLabel(btn, text) {

      label.textContent = text;
    }

    function render() {
      var size = currentSize();
      priceEls.forEach(function (el) { swapText(el, money(size.price)); });
      sizeEls.forEach(function (el) { swapText(el, size.label); });
      ctas.forEach(function (btn) {
        if (!btn.classList.contains('is-added')) setCtaLabel(btn, 'Add to bag · ' + money(total()));
      });
      if (upsellCard) upsellCard.classList.toggle('is-selected', !!(upsell && upsell.checked));
    }

    sizes.forEach(function (s) { s.addEventListener('change', render); });
    if (upsell) upsell.addEventListener('change', render);

    ctas.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (btn.tagName === 'A') e.preventDefault();
        var size = currentSize();
        var withSet = !!(upsell && upsell.checked);
        cartTotal += withSet ? 2 : 1;

        cartCounts.forEach(function (c) {
          c.textContent = String(cartTotal);
          c.classList.remove('is-bump');
          void c.offsetWidth;
          c.classList.add('is-bump');
        });

        ctas.forEach(function (b) {
          b.classList.add('is-added');
          setCtaLabel(b, 'Added to your bag');

        announce('Fig & Smoke, ' + size.label + (withSet ? ', with the Discovery Set,' : '') +
          ' added to your bag. ' + cartTotal + ' item' + (cartTotal === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' in bag.');

        window.clearTimeout(resetTimer);
        resetTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
          ctas.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('is-added'); });

    // mobile buy bar appears once the main button has scrolled away

        bar.classList.toggle('is-visible', visible);
        bar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!visible));
        bar.inert = !visible;
      };
      setBar(false);
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          var entry = entries[0];
          setBar(!entry.isIntersecting && entry.boundingClientRect.top < 0);

  /* ---------- Notes pyramid ---------- */
  function initPyramid() {
    var root = $('[data-pyramid]');
    if (!root) return;
    var pyramid = $('.pyramid', root);
    var tiers = $$('[data-tier]', root);
    var panels = $$('[data-tier-panel]', root);
    if (!tiers.length) return;

    function activate(name) {
      if (pyramid) pyramid.classList.add('has-active');
      tiers.forEach(function (t) {
        var on = t.dataset.tier === name;
        t.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
        t.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
      });
      panels.forEach(function (p) {
        var on = p.dataset.tierPanel === name;
        p.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
        p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!on));
      });
    }

    tiers.forEach(function (t) {
      var go = function () { activate(t.dataset.tier); };
      t.addEventListener('pointerenter', go);
      t.addEventListener('focus', go);
      t.addEventListener('click', go);
    });

    var initial = tiers.find(function (t) { return t.classList.contains('is-active'); }) || tiers[0];
    activate(initial.dataset.tier);
  }

  /* ---------- How it wears: 0h / 2h / 6h ---------- */
  function initWear() {
    var root = $('[data-wear]');
    if (!root) return;
    var stops = $$('[data-stop]', root);
    if (!stops.length) return;
    var interacted = false;
    var timers = [];

    function activate(i) {
      var last = Math.max(1, stops.length - 1);
      root.style.setProperty('--p', String(i / last));
      stops.forEach(function (s, k) {
        s.classList.toggle('is-active', k === i);
        s.classList.toggle('is-past', k < i);
        var btn = $('.wear__time', s);
        if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(k === i));
      });
    }

    function byUser(i) {
      interacted = true;
      timers.forEach(window.clearTimeout);
      activate(i);
    }

    stops.forEach(function (s, k) {
      s.addEventListener('pointerenter', function (e) { if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') byUser(k); });
      var btn = $('.wear__time', s);
      if (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () { byUser(k); });
        btn.addEventListener('focus', function () { byUser(k); });
      }
    });

    activate(0);

    // once in view, the scent "dries down" slowly on its own
    if (!reduceMotion && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        if (!entries.some(function (e) { return e.isIntersecting; })) return;
        io.disconnect();
        for (var s = 1; s < stops.length; s++) {
          (function (step) {
            timers.push(window.setTimeout(function () { if (!interacted) activate(step); }, 1800 * step));
          })(s);
        }
      }, { threshold: 0.45 });
      io.observe(root);
    }
  }

  /* ---------- Accordion: slow open / close on native <details> ---------- */
  function initAccordions() {
    $$('details.acc').forEach(function (d) {
      var summary = $('summary', d);
      var body = $('.acc__body', d);
      if (!summary || !body || !body.animate || reduceMotion) return;
      var anim = null;

      summary.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (anim) { anim.cancel(); anim = null; }

        if (d.open) {
          var h = body.offsetHeight;
          anim = body.animate(
            [{ height: h + 'px', opacity: 1 }, { height: '0px', opacity: 0 }],
            { duration: 560, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)' }
          );
          anim.onfinish = function () { d.open = false; anim = null; };
        } else {
          d.open = true;
          var target = body.offsetHeight;
          anim = body.animate(
            [{ height: '0px', opacity: 0 }, { height: target + 'px', opacity: 1 }],
            { duration: 760, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)' }
          );
          anim.onfinish = function () { anim = null; };
        }
      });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Reviews: show more ---------- */
  function initReviews() {
    var btn = $('[data-reviews-more]');
    if (!btn) return;
    var step = Number(btn.dataset.step) || 3;

    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var hidden = $$('.review[hidden]');

          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            window.requestAnimationFrame(function () { r.classList.remove('is-entering'); });
          });

      });

        batch[0].setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        batch[0].focus({ preventScroll: true });

        label.textContent = 'Read more reviews (' + remaining + ')';

Hooks the HTML will use

These names tie the HTML to the CSS and JS. I'll stick to them in the next reply.

  • Page setup
    • <html class="no-js">. The script swaps this to js, so with JavaScript off every section is still fully visible.
    • A visually hidden [data-live] region announces cart changes to screen readers.
  • Header
    • The header itself is .site-header, with the mobile menu button [data-menu-toggle].
    • The cart count is [data-cart-count], and .tool--hide-sm marks links that are hidden on mobile.
  • Gallery
    • The gallery is wrapped in [data-gallery].
    • Each thumbnail is a .gallery__thumb button carrying data-src, data-alt and aria-current.
    • The main image area is .gallery__stage[data-zoom], containing .gallery__img. The mobile arrows are [data-gallery-prev/next].
    • Below the image, [data-gallery-count] shows the position and [data-zoom-toggle] (with a [data-zoom-label] inside) switches zoom.
  • Size selector
    • Each size is a name="size" radio carrying data-price and data-label: 50 ml at $168, 10 ml travel at $48.
    • The displayed price and size are [data-price-display] and [data-size-display].
  • Discovery Set and add-to-bag
    • The Discovery Set is a [data-upsell] checkbox with data-price="32", inside .upsell.
    • Add-to-bag buttons are [data-add-to-bag] with a [data-cta-label] inside. The main one also has [data-primary-cta], which triggers the mobile [data-buy-bar].
  • Notes pyramid
    • The section is [data-pyramid].
    • The tiers are .tier buttons with data-tier="top|heart|base", each with a matching .tier-detail[data-tier-panel] panel.
  • How it wears
    • The section is [data-wear] on .wear__timeline, which contains .wear__fill.
    • Each stop is an li.wear__stop[data-stop] with a .wear__time button inside. The projection meters use --level.
  • Shipping & returns: each item is a native details.acc > summary + .acc__body > .acc__inner, so it opens and closes even without JavaScript.
  • Reviews: extra reviews start as .review[hidden], and the [data-reviews-more] button reveals them.
  • Fade-ins: elements marked .reveal fade in on scroll. They never go on the gallery's parent elements, because that would break the sticky gallery.

How the interactions behave

  • Zoom: on desktop the image magnifies on hover and follows the cursor. On touch screens, tap to zoom, drag to pan, and swipe to change image.
  • Fades: image changes, the notes pyramid, the timeline and the accordion all use slow 0.6–1.6s transitions. Reduced-motion settings switch them off.
  • "How it wears" timeline: once it scrolls into view, it steps slowly from 0h to 2h to 6h on its own. Hovering or tapping any stop takes over from the automatic play.
